welcome.title: Welcome to PADEL2GO!
welcome.body: Great to have you. We need a few details for your profile once — so other players can find you and we can rank you properly.

name.title: What's your name?
name.subtitle: Your username is your public handle, the display name is what other players see.
name.usernameHint: 3–30 characters, only a–z, 0–9, dot and underscore.
name.displayHint: How we greet you and how other players see you.

age.title: How old are you?
age.subtitle: We only use this for age groups in the ranking.
age.label: Age
age.invalid: Please enter an age between 18 and 99.

skill.title: How well do you play?
skill.subtitle: Your own estimate. Real matches will replace it later.
skill.gamesLabel: How many matches have you played?

avatar.title: Show yourself
avatar.subtitle: A photo is optional — without one we use your initials.
avatar.initialsHint: Without a photo your initials appear in your personal colour.
avatar.hasPhoto: Looking good! You can change the photo later in your account.
avatar.tooLarge: The image is larger than 5 MB.

done.title: You're all set!
done.subtitle: Give your details a quick check, then let's go.
done.editHint: You can change everything anytime under Account.
